source.original_question: During a rescue search, a helicopter flew west from point X to point Y, then changed course and flew to point Z. Now, calculate d to one decimal place.

adaptations.reason: Decorative scenery/icons removed; native mathematical lines, angle arcs, measurements and point relationships retained.

independent_solution.method: The335°bearing is25°west of north. d*cos25°=10.7, so d=10.7/cos25°=11.805..., rounding to11.8km.
